name: sitsmart
description: SitSmart - AI Ergonomics Live Platform (Sit Smart, Work Better)

scripts.start: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server install
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run serve

author: SitSmart Team
